executiveSummary: The durable fix belongs in infrastructure code because the exposed Grafana availability risk is best addressed through Terragrunt + Helm values.

confidenceLimiters: Repo edits must still be reviewed because chart behavior can vary by values file.

keyFindings.title: Exposed single-replica workload without HPA: monitoring/grafana
keyFindings.whyItMatters: A single exposed Grafana pod creates a fragile operational dependency during node drains and upgrades.

evidence.signal: Terragrunt stack points to modules/monitoring/grafana and values path helm-charts/monitoring/grafana/values-test.yaml

shortTerm.title: Raise Grafana replica count in infrastructure code and ship it via PR
shortTerm.expectedBenefit: Removes the live single point of failure while preserving GitOps/auditability.
shortTerm.riskTradeoff: Requires review to ensure the chart and values file support multi-replica behavior.
shortTerm.rollbackOutline: Revert the PR or set replica count back to one.

proposedOperatorMessage: Kube Ops Copilot: the exposed Grafana single-replica risk is best fixed in Terragrunt/Helm values, not by a direct cluster patch.
finalOperatorVerdict: Prefer infrastructure PR over ad-hoc live edits for this change.
